# Remove From Set

![Remove From Set function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/collection/set/03-remove-set.svg)

[Collection functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Removes the complete requested value, not an Array index. not included? is true if absent. Removing the last element preserves a typed empty Set.
